final: WITH large AS (SELECT account_id, type, amount, balance FROM trans WHERE amount >= 2400), per_acct AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -amount END) AS avg_signed, AVG(balance) AS avg_bal FROM large GROUP BY account_id) SELECT AVG(avg_signed) AS avg_signed_amount, AVG(avg_bal) AS avg_balance FROM per_acct
